scope: 2021 base first printing; Law October20 2020; full Playbook; official base first-printing errata dated November15 2022; multiplayer including Chronicle and later setup; bots and New Foundations excluded.
independence: Only assigned complete sources, questions/answer key and supplied ledger were read. No summary, readers, grades, separate scope files or other reviews/history files were read. Historical metadata inside the expressly allowed ledger was visible. No parent-supplied summary facts were used.

delivery.format_deviation: Original delivery omitted explicit outer max_output_tokens directive; nested budgets and chunk bounds were explicit and actual outputs complete/untruncated. Parent independently verified complete tool delivery and explicitly directed retaining the format deviation rather than unnecessary redelivery. Six Law chunks were repeated with both budgets explicit before that direction.

finding_summary: No distinct unasked material procedural rule or branch survived the complete-source challenge. One source-backed Q015 key correction is required: use attacking-force warbands as the die ceiling rather than wording that can imply an invariant board-only cap. Q015 already asks how attack is calculated, so correcting its general operator does not earn novelty for a power-expanded numerical instance. This is a working coverage verdict, not an assertion that the current key wording needs no correction, nor an exhaustive or held-out claim.

illustrative_regression_only.question: Your board has three warbands. Before attack dice are collected, an applicable printed power has added four physical warbands at a site to your attacking force. With no other attack-die modifiers, what is the maximum number of attack dice you may collect? Does the normal board-only count still cap the pool? The power’s effect is given; you do not need to identify or recall a named card.
illustrative_regression_only.exact_expected_answer: The maximum is seven attack dice, because the corrected limit is the number of warbands in your attacking force, including the four added by the applicable power. It is not capped at the three physically on your board. You may choose fewer dice; subsequent dice modifiers still apply normally.
